query:
SELECT asset_public_id, (embedding <#> $3) AS "raw_rank!"
                FROM asset_embeddings
                WHERE model_pack_id = $1
                  AND owner_id = $2
                  AND asset_trashed_at IS NULL
                ORDER BY embedding <#> $3 ASC, asset_created_at DESC, asset_public_id ASC
                LIMIT $4
